Kill [[Plague of Destruction]] and accompanying foes.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in [[Raven's Point]].
* *BONUS* Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[norn rank|Norn reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[Defending the Breach]]. Note that unlike that quest, you have to defeat all the [[Destroyers]] in the final room to finish this (as with spawning [[Destroyer Chest|the chest]]).
